measures.what: body length, width, height, mounting flange dimensions, mounting hole diameter and spacing, and output shaft position from the short edge
measures.reply: servo body length: 40.58 mm (the case, end to end, not counting the tabs); servo body width: 19.82 mm (the case, side to side); servo body height: 40.4 mm (the case, top to bottom); servo tab holes: 4.58 mm (each mounting tab has two holes, open to the tab's end like a U); servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab); servo spline: 5.84 mm (the output shaft, across its splines, where an arm would grip it; there's a smaller reading of 5.60 at the very top, and I'm not sure which feature that was); servo shaft position: near one end of the case, in the middle side to side (I didn't measure how far it is from the end, or how high it stands above the case)

measures.what: horn type (disc, single arm, four-arm), dimensions, screw hole spacing, and center screw size/length
measures.reply: servo body length: 40.58 mm (the case, end to end, not counting the tabs); servo tab holes: 4.58 mm (each mounting tab has two holes, open to the tab's end like a U); servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab); servo horns: four plastic horns came with it (a double arm, a six-arm star, a round disc and a cross), and I bought a 25-tooth aluminium single arm (the aluminium arm's hub is 14.66 across and 5.95 thick, the arm 3.86 thick, 34.62 from the hub's far edge to the tip, with 2.55 holes; I didn't measure where the holes are, or the plastic horns)

measures.what: width and outer diameter (square in the caliper jaws)
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.
